baseline_source: NIST SP 800-53B, Control Baselines for Information Systems and Organizations
note: Subset of controls assessed by this tool. Titles follow NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5; summaries are short paraphrases. Verify baseline membership against the official NIST publication before relying on it for formal assessments.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.summary: Define, create, review, and remove system accounts according to organizational policy.

controls.title: Account Management | Disable Accounts
controls.summary: Disable accounts that are expired, no longer needed, or inactive beyond a defined period.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.summary: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.summary: Allow only the access users need to accomplish their assigned tasks.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.summary: Limit consecutive invalid logon attempts and lock the account when the limit is exceeded.

controls.title: Device Lock
controls.summary: Lock a device after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.summary: Establish and enforce requirements for each type of remote access.

controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness
controls.summary: Provide security and privacy awareness training to system users.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.summary: Identify and log the event types needed to support security monitoring and investigation.

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.summary: Review and analyze audit records on a defined frequency for signs of inappropriate activity.

controls.title: Audit Record Retention
controls.summary: Retain audit records for a defined period to support investigations.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.summary: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.summary: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for system components.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.summary: Configure systems to provide only essential capabilities and disable unnecessary services.

controls.title: System Backup
controls.summary: Back up system-level and user-level information and protect the confidentiality and integrity of backups.

controls.title: System Backup | Testing for Reliability and Integrity
controls.summary: Test backup information on a defined frequency to verify media reliability and information integrity.

controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.summary: Provide for recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state after disruption.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.summary: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication | Multi-factor Authentication to Privileged Accounts
controls.summary: Require multi-factor authentication for access to privileged accounts.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication | Multi-factor Authentication to Non-privileged Accounts
controls.summary: Require multi-factor authentication for access to non-privileged accounts.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.summary: Manage authenticators, including password composition and strength requirements.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.summary: Implement an incident handling capability covering preparation, detection, containment, and recovery.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.summary: Develop, review, and update an incident response plan.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.summary: Scan for vulnerabilities on a defined frequency and remediate legitimate findings.

controls.title: Unsupported System Components
controls.summary: Replace system components when vendor support is no longer available, or provide justified alternatives.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.summary: Monitor and control communications at external and key internal system boundaries.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.summary: Implement the types of cryptography required for each specified use.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.summary: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.summary: Identify, report, and correct system flaws, installing security updates within defined time periods.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.summary: Implement malicious code protection at system entry and exit points.

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.summary: Monitor the system to detect attacks, indicators of compromise, and unauthorized use.
